---
title: 'Generate USD Account (Sandbox)'
openapi: 'POST /accounts/{accountId}/bank-accounts/generate'
---

Generates the USD deposit account once its details have been [submitted](/api-reference/endpoint/accounts/submit-bank-account) and accepted by the banking partner's sandbox. This is the last step the Rolla team takes on a USD request in production.

<Warning>
  **Sandbox / testing only.** This endpoint does **not** exist in production — calls to the production API return `404 Not Found`. In production, USD accounts are generated by the Rolla team.
</Warning>

## Prerequisites

The details were [submitted](/api-reference/endpoint/accounts/submit-bank-account) and the response said `readyToGenerate: true`.

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `currency` | string | Yes | Must be `"USD"`. |

## Example Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api-staging.rolla.xyz/api/v1/external/accounts/eec3cbed-79d8-4370-87a0-b6be9e287337/bank-accounts/generate" \
  -H "X-API-Key: your_api_key_here" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "currency": "USD" }'
```

## Example Response

```json
{
  "status": 201,
  "message": "Bank account generated",
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "status": "issued",
    "bankAccount": {
      "id": "a572f509-f16b-47bc-aa6f-cd875db581ea",
      "currency": "USD",
      "bankName": "Portage Bank",
      "accountNumber": "5a8886a6-8012-4311-835c-50d68ccd1f31",
      "accountName": "Amara Okafor",
      "routingNumber": "125109064",
      "swiftCode": "ROUTUS22XXX",
      "bankAddress": {
        "city": "Bellevue",
        "line1": "880 108th Ave NE",
        "state": "WA",
        "country": "US",
        "postalCode": "98004"
      },
      "type": "static",
      "status": "active",
      "reference": null,
      "label": null,
      "expiresAt": null,
      "createdAt": "2026-11-02T09:29:59.039Z"
    }
  }
}
```

<Note>
  Account numbers in the banking partner's sandbox are not in the format real ones use. Production accounts carry a normal US account number.
</Note>

## What happens

1. The deposit account is created with the banking partner and returned as `bankAccount`.
2. The USD request is closed as fulfilled, and the [`account.virtual_account.created`](/api-reference/webhooks/events) webhook is sent.
3. [Request a USD account](/api-reference/endpoint/accounts/issue-bank-account) and [List Bank Accounts](/api-reference/endpoint/accounts/list-bank-accounts) now return this account.

Calling it again returns `200` with `status: "already_exists"` and the same account, so it is safe to retry.

<Tip>
  Test money into the new account with [Simulate an Account Deposit](/api-reference/endpoint/accounts/simulate-deposit).
</Tip>

## Errors

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| `400` | — | `currency` is missing or not `"USD"`. |
| `409` | `APPLICATION_NOT_APPROVED` | The account is not approved yet. |
| `409` | `ONBOARDING_NOT_SUBMITTED` | The details have not been [submitted](/api-reference/endpoint/accounts/submit-bank-account) yet. |
| `409` | `PROVIDER_REVIEW_PENDING` | The banking partner has not accepted the details yet. The message names its current state. Submit again, correcting anything it rejected. |
| `422` | — | The banking partner refused to create the account; `errors` lists why. |
| `404` | — | Called in production, or the account does not belong to you. |
